name: Accessibility pass
description: Audit and improve one user journey for keyboard, semantic, visual, motion, and assistive technology quality.

outcomes.description: The targeted journey has an explicit result for keyboard, focus, semantics, contrast, and assistive output.
A receipt records covered states, remaining limitations, and a safe follow-up path.

prerequisites.description: The user journey, supported inputs, important states, and expected inclusive behavior are named.
prerequisites.check: Write the path and its loading, empty, error, and success states.

prerequisites.description: The journey can be inspected in a safe local or preview environment.
prerequisites.check: Confirm that no credential value or live mutation is needed for the audit.

lanes.objective: Map the journey, assistive expectations, and evidence checklist.
Apply focused semantic, focus, contrast, or motion improvements in the owned scope.
Run keyboard, focus, semantic, visual, and assistive output checks against the brief.

qualityGates.description: The journey is usable with keyboard navigation, visible focus, and predictable focus recovery.
Names, roles, states, contrast, and motion behavior match the declared user journey.
Uncovered combinations and known limitations are stated rather than implied away.

ownerConfirmationBoundaries.action: Enter a password, one-time code, passkey, or challenge response during an accessibility check.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.boundary: Stop and hand the entry to the owner; inspect only safe content after access is already available.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.reason: Authentication material is a human-only boundary.

ownerConfirmationBoundaries.action: Change billing, account security, destructive data, or live financial behavior while auditing the journey.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.boundary: Stop before the action and obtain one explicit owner confirmation for that individual action.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.reason: Accessibility work belongs in a safe test or preview path.

rollbackRescue.rollbackPlan: Keep the before-state audit and return to the last known-good integration point if an inclusive behavior regresses.
rescueSteps: Capture redacted tree, keyboard, and visual summaries.
Preserve the focused semantic or style patch.
Record the uncovered state and mark the lane abandoned when proof is incomplete.
stopConditions: The journey cannot be reached safely.
A protected owner boundary is reached.

redactionRules: Omit credentials, tokens, private paths, and private page content.
Use redacted captures and safe route names only.
